rotDef: true bearing (deg clockwise from north) of the scene -z axis (canopy rows, 'back' of the farm). Scene +x points to rotDeg+90 = 43 deg (NE). Front of the farm (+z, entrance, inverters) faces 133 deg (SE, toward the Agrofirma parking).

sceneOrigin.note: lat/lon/x2180/y2180/x2176/y2176 above are the geodetic position of scene (0,0,0); y=0 = ground, ~38 m a.s.l. (phone GPS altitude 36-43 m)

anchor.source: EXIF GPS of photos IMG_9403 (heading 142.9 deg, at the inverters) and IMG_9406 (heading 71.2 deg), 2026-11-03, horizontal accuracy 3.5 m; the 13 trip videos (QuickTime ISO6709, 4 decimals) agree within ~10 m

crs.EPSG:2180: PL-1992, TM lon0=19 k=0.9993 FE=500000 FN=-5300000 (grid convergence -3.15 deg here)

mapping: scene(x,z) -> true-north metres: dE = x*cos(b) - z*sin(b), dN = -x*sin(b) - z*cos(b), b = rotDeg; inverse x = dE*cos(b) - dN*sin(b), z = -dE*sin(b) - dN*cos(b). lib/geo.js implements the exact TM projections (sceneToLatLon / latLonToScene / sceneTo2180 / sceneTo2176).

confidence.position: high, +/-5 m (photo GPS 3.5 m at the inverters + the camera stood ~1-2 m away)
confidence.rotation: medium, +/-6 deg: rows assumed parallel to the road, the field tramlines and the SW edge of the Sentinel-2 plot outline (133-134 deg); the coordinator's S2 long-axis estimate is ~129 deg; rows were not seen from above
confidence.section: assumption: the modelled 36x42 m patch is the south (entrance/inverter) corner of the ~250x95 m plot; the real plot continues ~250 m NW (-z) and ~100 m NE (+x)
